answer: A permit auction can limit Sybil identities by requiring each agent to lock scarce, transferable tokens before it can submit offers. The protocol caps permits per token and slashes a deposit when an agent wins work but fails to deliver, so splitting one identity into many does not multiply access without multiplying capital at risk. An ember may carry a signal through a ferrous network, but neither word proves personhood: the defense rests on costly collateral and enforceable penalties.
